item.title: Dad Rubs It In Son’s Face Six Years After Being Told “Don’t Worry Dad, This Virus Shit Will Be Forgotten When The News Cycle Moves On”
item.description:
MELBOURNE — A father has spent the better part of Saturday morning reminding his adult son that, six years ago, the son confidently assured him the Wuhan Virus would “be forgotten the second the news cycle moves on”.

Tom Frampton, 42, made the prediction in January 2020 while attempting to calm his increasingly agitated father, who had been watching news stories about a “mysterious pneumonia” in the Chinese province of Hubei.

item.title: REPORT: At Every Timeline Branch During Wuhan Virus Crisis, Authorities Chose Worst Available Option
item.description:
GENEVA — Temporal researchers have concluded that at nearly every major decision point during the Wuhan Pandemic, governments across the Western world somehow selected the branch producing the greatest combination of social damage, economic destruction, institutional distrust and subsequent refusal to admit anything had gone wrong.

The findings come from a three-year study by the Institute for Applied Temporal Mechanics, whose researchers analysed hundreds of thousands of parallel universes created by individual policy decisions made between 2020 and 2022.

item.title: Unvaccinated Cops Welcomed Back Years After Trauma Of The Century Memory-Holed
item.description:
SYDNEY — Police officers who refused the COVID vaccine have been warmly invited to return to the force years after being stood down, dismissed, shamed, isolated, treated as operational contaminants and informed that public service was impossible without total medical compliance.

The move comes after officials determined that enough time had passed for the entire episode to be discussed in the emotionally neutral language of “workforce recovery”, “re-engagement”, “lessons learned” and “moving forward”, rather than the more difficult language of “we bullied people during a panic and now need staff”.
